page.layout: One printed page, text block with a closing signature below it. A narrow strip of the neighbouring page is visible at the right edge and is not transcribed. Running head at top centre.

main_text.p: quam de Tua Celf. conceperunt, exspe-ctationi & spei non satisfacias tātum, sed superes etiam, rebus pro Ecclesiæ & Pa-triæ communis felicitate & trāquillitate fortiter geredis, ad nominis sui sacrosan-ctigloriam, electorū, & Tuæ ipsius Celf. salutem æternam, adque nomen etiam Celf. Tuæ & memoriam apud posteros sempiternam atq; immortalem. Amen. Scriptum Herbornæ 13. Calend. Martii, anno à partu virgineo 1604.

page.notes: The right edge shows part of the adjoining page (margin notes and text), excluded as neighbouring-page edge. The sign-off "Illustriss. Celf. Tuam" and "Humillimè colens & observans" are set in italic. No page number is printed on this page. The letter's "atq;" is transcribed with the printed abbreviation mark; the scan is slightly soft there.
